purpose: Cut bounded subtractive features into observed rigid static UC rectangular-prism GLBs, including rotated stock, persistent notch chains, persistent hole chains, general same-axis hole sweeps, and v0.7 hash-linked mixed same-axis hole-plus-notch fabrication.

properties.source_path: existing ordinary .glb creation outside protected live machine body
properties.path: distinct target .glb path outside protected live machine body
properties.specification: closed v0.2/v0.3 single-cut recipe, v0.4 notch-chain recipe, v0.5/v0.6 hole-chain recipe, or axm.mesh-mixed-fabrication-chain/v0.7 same-axis mixed operation recipe
properties.expected_source_sha256: optional exact lowercase SHA-256 binding, with optional sha256: prefix
properties.lineage_path: optional prior lineage receipt; v0.7 accepts verified v0.4 notch, v0.5/v0.6 hole, or v0.7 mixed lineage parents
properties.receipt_path: optional distinct output receipt path; defaults beside the output GLB
properties.expected_lineage_sha256: optional exact prior lineage SHA-256 binding

contains: exact source and output GLB SHA-256 bindings
proven rectangular-prism root frame and source topology evidence
hash-linked cumulative operation lineage and receipt digest
exact deterministic parent-output reconstruction before continuation
v0.7 unified same-axis sweep over interior round holes and boundary-open box notches
v0.7 explicit omission of outer stock walls only where a notch opens to the exterior
stable resolved physical operation digests across lineage continuation
non-overlap/non-touch gate across hole-hole, notch-notch and hole-notch pairs
exact mixed removed-area and closed-mesh volume agreement
closed oriented edge-manifold candidate evidence and procedural-3D GLB validation

relationships: reuses the static GLB geometry decoder, seam-weld topology inspector, proven oriented stock frame, deterministic GLB publisher and validator
v0.4 remains the verified bounded cumulative box-notch path
v0.5 and v0.6 remain the verified cumulative round-hole paths
v0.7 unifies same-axis holes and boundary-open notches in one deterministic cross-section sweep rather than gluing independently generated meshes
v0.7 omits cut walls only on the exact stock boundary through which a notch opens while retaining the three newly exposed notch walls
v0.7 rejects touching or overlapping cut polygons so mixed removed-volume receipts remain additive and exact
v0.7 can consume v0.4/v0.5/v0.6 lineage only after the corresponding legacy compiler exactly rebuilds the supplied parent GLB, then emits a new v0.7 lineage
all older cutter schemas delegate through their previously registered paths unchanged
limitations: v0.7 mixed fabrication remains bounded to at most 32 non-overlapping/non-touching round-through-hole and box-notch operations on one proven fabrication axis of one rigid rectangular-prism root stock.
Cross-axis cumulative fabrication remains unavailable rather than approximated.
v0.7 is a bounded rectangular-stock cross-section subtraction sweep, not general arbitrary 3D boolean CSG or arbitrary imported-mesh surgery.
Multiple source primitives/components, skins, animation, morphs, UVs, textures, tangents, vertex colours, joints and unsupported material state remain rejected by the existing source boundary.

Legacy lineage migration is exact-output-verified before conversion, but the v0.7 receipt rehashes imported physical operations under the v0.7 operation grammar while retaining the parent lineage digest and migration receipt.
Lineage receipts are content-hashed and exact-output-bound, but are not cryptographic authorship signatures or external trust anchors.
Edge-manifold topology, non-overlap and volume accounting are checked; visual quality, structural strength, real manufacturing behavior and host-engine import remain unproven.

truth.basis: Exact source/frame state, resolved hole/notch geometry, operation hashes, parent lineage, deterministic prior reconstruction, mixed sweep decomposition, topology, volume agreement, output digest and limitations are explicit.

agency.basis: The caller chooses the stock, fabrication axis, ordered mixed operations, dimensions, kerf, continuation receipt and replacement decision; overlap, cross-axis and unsupported freeform requests fail closed.

continuity.basis: Source artifacts remain read-only, prior v0.4-v0.7 output is exactly reconstructed before continuation, parent receipt digests remain linked, and output/receipt publication retains rollback behavior.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: v0.7 adds only the smallest mixed-operation generalization whose geometry, non-overlap, manifoldness and removed volume can be deterministically checked before publication.
